system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (18).
Once per long rest on a success, you
reconfigure the surrounding combat
zone anywhere within Far range using
field engineering gear, demolition
charges, deployable barricades,
construction drones, foamcrete, road
spikes, cutting lasers, or compromised
infrastructure.
For example, you can clear a path
through dense debris, collapse
unstable cover, open a breach through
a wrecked zone, raise a wall of scrap
and barricades, expose buried
infrastructure, create a ramp or bridge,
or alter the battlefield’s available cover.
The change must be something that
could plausibly be accomplished
through machinery, demolition or
construction.
